response.summary: Overall notebook quality is mixed: the core ML setup is sound (stratified split and a proper preprocessing/model pipeline, with sensible metrics for class imbalance), but the work is not reproducible and the written conclusions do not match the executed results. The most important finding is that the notebook does not run end-to-end (a NameError in cell 8), and it makes critical performance claims (e.g., “0.80 prepaid recall” and “feature importances”) that are not actually computed—while the only shown test recall is 0.119. In interview, ask her to run the notebook from a clean kernel without manual fixes, then explain exactly how she computed any segment-level recall and what thresholding/validation approach she used; also have her clarify the difference between model coefficients and feature importances and produce the correct analysis.
